focus: The community, ranks, join, and vault-wall pages now load faster: a script that used to block the page from drawing is deferred, so content paints sooner. A new automatic check keeps the studio's most important pages free of render-blocking scripts going forward.
nextStep: Confirm the faster ranks page passes its performance check, then bring the same render-blocking-script cleanup to the remaining pages.
